texts.title: Notice
texts.content:
ELEVATOR OUT OF SERVICE
Repairs are expected to finish by Wednesday evening
Please use the stairs at the end of the hall
Residents who need help carrying groceries or packages can call the front desk at extension 0
We are sorry for the trouble

questions.stem: What can residents do if they need help with heavy items?
options: C. Leave packages in the hall
questions.explanation: Residents "who need help carrying groceries or packages can call the front desk at extension 0."

questions.stem: Where would this sign most likely be found?
questions.explanation: The sign addresses "Residents" and mentions a front desk, which suggests a residential building.
